title_zh: 网页智能体应采用“先规划后执行”范式
one_line: Position paper arguing web agents should plan a fixed program over typed site APIs before seeing untrusted content; supported only by a WebArena task-compatibility analysis.

online_eval.quote: We analyze WebArena, a popular web agent benchmark, and find that all tasks are compatible with plan-then-execute, while 80% can be completed with a purely programmatic plan, without any runtime LLM subroutine.
